new_string: - [DONE] Phase 2 / Builder 9 — view_submission validation tier (with edit-flow diff) + stub view-builder swap-in. New `src/lib/slack/modals/validate-submission.ts` (~590 LOC) reusing Wave 0b validators (`normalizeEmptyToNull`, `validateStatusCategoryCompatibility`, `validateRoleTagOnResources`, `validateStartEndDateOrder`, `validatePastDateNonTerminal`, `validateNotesMaxLength`) + modal-specific rules: parent-must-be-retainer (Project, non-retainer mode), lazy parent resolution via `pendingProjectName` fuzzy match (single match → set parentProjectId; no match → PARENT_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND; multi-match → ambiguous error), title-collision soft-warn (Sørensen-Dice ≥ 0.85 via shared `src/lib/runway/fuzzy-match.ts`), wrapper-vs-child date-extension soft-warn (project edit when parent retainer's contract range exceeded). Edit flow: target-still-exists check (target deleted between modal-open and submit → error) + changed-field diff (compute keys whose normalized value differs from `currentValues`; only validate those; no-change submit → error). Returns `{ ok: true, normalized, changedFields?, softWarnings? } | { ok: false, errors: blockId-keyed }`. Block IDs match the live modal builders (Builders 4/5/6) — fixtures in `tests/fixtures/slack/view-submission-*` predate the final builders and are NOT used as block-id source-of-truth. 38 new tests covering every rule + every soft-warn + lazy resolution paths (resolved_project_id pre-set / single-match / no-match / multi-match) + edit-flow paths (target-still-exists / changed-field diff / no-changes / single legit change). **Plus carryover swap:** `src/app/api/slack/commands/route.ts` now imports `buildTaskModal` / `buildProjectModal` / `buildTeamMemberModal` directly (was stubs with `__debug` field marked `TODO(orchestrator)`); stub builder + `pickHeader` removed. Route tests updated to mock the modal builders so the same `__debug` assertions still work end-to-end (real builders are tested in their own files). Tests: 2581 passed / 19 skipped (+34 net new vs Phase 1 baseline of 2547). Lint: 0 errors / 11 pre-existing warnings.
